triage.desk_query: Term sheet G07 states: "Autocall Observation Dates and Autocall Levels (as a percentage of the Initial Level): 20 January 2027 at 100%, 20 January 2028 at 95%, 20 July 2028 at 90%." The booking record field autocall_level_pct is set to ['100', '100', '100'], i.e. a flat 100% barrier at all three observation dates, which does not reflect the stepping schedule. Please confirm the note is a stepping autocall at 100% / 95% / 90% and have the booking amended to match, or advise if the flat 100% booking reflects a term agreed outside the term sheet.
